project.name: WiiXLaunch_BotW
project.author: Modder
project.description: Cross-platform Breath of the Wild Mod powered by WiiXLaunch

identity.//: The slice the host CRCs to name this build. READ-ONLY DATA, never .text - .text is what mods rewrite, so a fingerprint over it would identify the installed mod set as much as the build. Enrol a build by pasting the fingerprint the boot log prints into `known`.
identity.//switch: Offset from where exlaunch says read-only data starts, not from the module base - the host asks rather than making this file carry an address. 0x600000 lands in .rodata.1 string constants; read at 0x7101e03000 in the v1.5.0 main it is UTF-8 text and `ssao_is_depth_full`. A smaller offset would land in .rela.dyn, which begins only 0x50 bytes into the RO segment.
identity.//wiiu: An ADDRESS, because the host cannot find its own image bounds on Wii U or Cemu - the same reason Patches::InGameImage returns true instead of checking. .rodata is 0x10000000-0x10462BBB in the v208 RPX; 0x10200000 holds GameData flag names (IsGet_Item_InsectGet_K ...), which are ASCII, differ per build, and carry no relocated pointers. The RPX was confirmed to be v208 first: 0x02000030 holds 7C 9E 23 78 and 0x02000034 holds 7C 7F 1B 79, the two instructions examples/patch_mod documents.
